The *Dutiyakuṭivihārittheragāthā* is a poetic text preserved within the *Theragāthā*, cataloged under the single-verse section (*Ekakanipāta*) as verse 57 of the collection [SuttaCentral]. Positioned in the early Buddhist canonical corpus of the Pali *Khuddakanikāya*, the poem conveys the verse attributed to a second elder associated with dwelling in a hut (*kuṭivihārin*) [SuttaCentral]. In modern scholarship and translation, the text is represented on SuttaCentral by twelve translations spanning ten languages, including an English rendering by Bhikkhu Sujato [SuttaCentral].
